title: Incident response under a shared change window
description: A service outage affects several customer teams. Each responder owns one investigation. Responders can collect evidence, communicate progress, apply a reviewed fix, or escalate. One change window prevents simultaneous production fixes. One tick represents five minutes.
guidelines: Investigate before proposing a fix; avoid changes without evidence.
Keep customers informed while the incident is active.
Prefer escalation when a responder is unsure about the fix.
assumptions: Synthetic scenario, not a calibrated reliability forecast.
Each responder represents an independent investigation; fixes do not automatically resolve other investigations.
Investigation, review and communication durations are assumed.

roles.name: Experienced responder
roles.goal: Restore service with an evidence-backed fix and useful customer updates.

roles.name: New responder
roles.goal: Avoid a risky change; investigate carefully and escalate uncertainty to an expert.

actions.label: Gather diagnostic evidence before making a change
Send a status update while retaining the current investigation
Apply an evidence-backed fix in the shared production change window
Escalate this investigated issue for specialist follow-up
